tagline: Bid your tricks against the Avondale table. The joker is the boss.

rulesSummary: Partners sit across. 43 cards: 4s up to aces (no black 4s), plus the joker.
33 cards: 7s up to aces, plus the joker. Everyone scores alone; the contractor plays against the other two together, who each score 10 for every trick they take.
53 cards: a full pack and the joker. Everyone scores alone.
After the kitty, the contractor calls a card (not the joker or a bower): whoever holds it is a secret partner until it's played. Or choose Play alone. Misère is always alone.
Made with a partner, each of you wins half the bid; alone, all of it. Failed, you each lose the same. Each opponent scores 10 a trick.
Two teams of three, sitting alternately. 63 cards: a full pack and the joker, plus the 2s, 3s and red 4s of a second pack.
Two identical cards in a trick: the first one played wins. In misère both partners sit out.

options.label: Only win by making a bid

rulesSummary: Win the bid, then take at least the tricks you named. First to 500 with a bid they make wins.
10 cards each and 3 face down in the kitty. Bid how many tricks (6–10) you'll take, in a trump suit or no trumps (NT). Once you pass you're out. Nobody bids? New deal.
Bid values: 6♠ 40, then ♣ ♦ ♥ NT 20 more each; every extra trick adds 100 (7♠ 140 … 10 NT 520). Each bid must beat the last; misère ranks just above the sevens, open misère between 10♦ and 10♥.
The winner takes the kitty, discards 3 and leads. Follow suit if you can. Trumps from the top: joker, right bower (J of trumps), left bower (other J of that colour), A K Q 10…

In NT the joker has no suit and wins any trick. Play it only when you can't follow, or lead it by calling a suit not yet led. A contractor holding it may first make it the top card of a suit (in misère they must).

Misère (250, only over a seven): take no tricks, in NT, playing alone. Open misère (500, over anything below 10♥): the same, hand face up after trick 1. A defender who can't follow must play the joker.
Make it: score the bid (all 10 tricks: at least 250). Fail: lose the bid. Opponents score 10 a trick (nothing against misère).
Reaching 500 on defence alone doesn't win: you need a bid you make (a lobby option). Fall to −500 and you lose.
